method: Static source review plus independent source-engine/local fixture tests; no live endpoint or build

independentTests.timing: Before the subsequent admission-presentation and capture-owned cleanup additions; parent owns their final integration validation

findings.evidence: Image admission permits unknown model modalities when adapter supports image; PDF admission rejects only an explicit false optional supportsInputFile predicate. Initial coverage.ts required true declarations for both.
findings.resolution: Parent preserved conservative account verification while computing image dispatchAllowed with modelDeclared !== false and allowing an absent optional PDF predicate. Added unknown-image/custom-PDF fixtures observed in source.

findings.evidence: An env variable name alone can identify different resolved accounts after its value changes; identical reference/source/runtime hashes must not imply the same resolved account.
findings.resolution: Parent now creates an opaque per-invocation account reference and explicitly denies persistent account identity or cross-run reuse. Credential file path is identified only by SHA-256; raw key/account values remain private.

findings.evidence: A capture can receive then reject a response before the adapter obtains it. Provider helpers intentionally sanitize transport-thrown cleanup codes, so adapter/native cleanup alone cannot prove that capture-owned body joined.
findings.resolution: Central executor tracks physicalUnknown independently and denies account/native credit. Anthropic lane now cancels its own rejected body within one second and preserves host capture cleanup uncertainty in native records; 66 focused tests passed. PDF's own rejected-body path now has bounded cancellation and original native wrapper errors. Its host-injected transport throw still requires the final preservation check by PDF writer.

approvedBoundaries: PDF is a bounded authored one-page probe through native Responses input_file.file_data; no general PDF parser or file_url/file_id claim
PDF requires provider and exact model support plus both unknown-document-cost opt-ins; estimates remain null/incomplete
PDF exact recognition, foreign source owner denial, duplicate conflict, restart and archive no-replay require original native records and bytes
Media selection is exact gpt-4.1-2025-04-14 via bounded RGB AVI frame projection to Responses images; native video transport is false
Media validation requires original source/runtime unchanged, exact native Attempt/Part cleanup, exact ordered recognition, PNG pixels/CRC/timestamps and source identity
Media execution/fetch hooks remain fixture evidence; historical reports do not certify the newly selected model
Unknown audio/video/document token costs remain null and require host policy
Coverage is detached immutable presentation; supplied evidence never grants adapter/model support or execution authority
limits: Static review and local fixtures do not establish additional account/model capabilities
Final merged/source-qualified tests and actual account credit remain parent-owned
Public reasoning summary and remote cancellation account behavior remain unverified for Anthropic
No live requests, credential discovery, shared build, foreign-path edits or commit were performed by this review
approval: Accept bounded PDF/media/public-capability design after the pending PDF host-capture cleanup preservation check and final parent integration tests
